checks.text: Clicking the "Start" button begins a 25-minute countdown.
Clicking "Pause" stops the countdown, shows the status text "Paused", and renames the button "Resume".
Clicking "Reset" stops the countdown and returns to 25:00.
With "Work minutes" set to 1, after one minute of running the display shows "05:00" (the 5-minute break) and the status text "Break".
Clicking "Switch" toggles between work and break modes.
Typing "30" in the field labelled "Work minutes" changes the display to "30:00" (when idle on work).
The timer updates every second while running.
Closing the tab and reopening the app retains the last interval setting.
Reload keeps the current interval and state (e.g., "25:00" or "05:00").
